item.title: Perseid Meteor Shower Stargazing Party — Wed Aug 12, 8:30 PM — Millport Conservancy
item.description:
[vc_row][vc_column width=”1/1″][vc_column_text uncode_shortcode_id=”754851″]Join us at Millport Conservancy for an unforgettable Perseid Meteor Shower Stargazing Party—right during its dazzling peak. Get ready for one of the most spectacular sky shows of the year! When: Wednesday, August 12 | 8:30 PM–10:30 PM Where: Millport Conservancy, Lititz, PA. Just minutes from Lancaster—yet light-years away from skyglow! Cost: FREE The Perseid meteor shower is famous for producing up to 100 meteors per hour, including brilliant fireballs—flashes of light so bright they can rival Venus in the night sky. item.title: Children's Chapel — Sun Aug 16, 10:30 AM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Children’s Chapel* meets weekly during the 10:30 AM Sunday Mass. Children and youth ages 3 and above begin the morning in the sanctuary where they can experience the processional and the opening congregational prayers. After the opening Collect, children are invited to the front of the sanctuary to make their way to the chapel and participate in songs, prayers, brief meditation and storytelling of the day’s Gospel and/or New and Old Testament readings. The Godly Play® teaching method includes using beautiful wooden figures, candles, and symbolic colors to aid our storytelling as we listen to God’s word for us. Children often respond to the story using simple art supplies including crayons, construction paper, origami paper and Model Magic air dry clay. Children return to the Sanctuary during the passing of the Peace. They are welcome to take part in Holy Communion.
Source: Saint James Lancaster

item.title: Dillsburg Game Night - Calvary Methodist Church in the Family Center — Wed Aug 19, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Central PA Game Club Dillsburg Game Night meets every Wednesday from 6:30-9:30pm for casual tabletop games. We’ve been going strong since 2016, and most Wednesdays you’ll find about 30-40 gamers who love to learn and teach new games. It’s a great group of friendly people.
Given the timeframe, most of the games played are light to medium Euros, although many of us also love card games (including trick-taking games) and party games. We have a library of about 200 games available to play, and people typically bring their own games as well.
We also run long game days (typically every other month, usually a Saturday 2-9pm) and other special events. Join us on Facebook or Discord for more information about those.
Attendees do not often RSVP on Meetup. It may show 1 person is coming but we have 40 people every Wednesday and will cancel the event if it is not happening. Feel free to message with questions.
Cost: Free Who: All Ages (15 and under must be accompanied by an adult) When: Every

item.title: Evening Compline — Sat Aug 15, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster
